text: For the leader. Do not destroy! A psalm of Asaph; a song.
I We thank you, God, we give thanks;we call upon your name,we declare your wonderful deeds.[You said:] [1]
"I will choose the time;I will judge fairly.
Though the earth and all its inhabitants quake,I make steady its pillars." [AA]Selah
II So I say to the boastful: "Do not boast!" [AB]to the wicked: "Do not raise your horns! [2]
Do not raise your horns against heaven!Do not speak with a stiff neck!" [AC]
For judgment comes not from east or from west,not from the wilderness or the mountains, [AD]
But from God who decides,who brings some low and raises others high. [AE]
Yes, a cup [3] is in the Lord's hand,foaming wine, fully spiced. [4]When God pours it out,they will drain it even to the dregs;all the wicked of the earth will drink. [AF]
But I will rejoice forever;I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,
t[AG] [Who has said:]"I will cut off all the horns of the wicked,but the horns of the righteous will be exalted."
